Market internals suggest institutional money moved early on clearer information (likely scrims or lineup news). The LoL scene is thin enough that +$270K moves represent genuine conviction, not noise.

## WATCH LIST TODAY

1. **Hormuz August 31 (1% | $663K vol)** – Could be the most mispriced market on the board if tensions escalate even marginally. Asymmetric upside if new news breaks.

2. **Elon Tweet 65-89 (98% | Vol spike incoming?)** – Monitor whether volume sustains above $150K or crashes. Capitulation at 98% historically precedes reversals; entry point for contrarians emerges if vol collapses.
